## Compforge

This project follows **Compforge**, a component-architecture methodology pack for
TypeScript + React. Read the pack before writing or changing UI code.

**Resolve the pack root in order:** `$COMPFORGE_HOME` → `~/.compforge`.
If neither exists, say so and stop — do not reconstruct the rules from this block.
Install: <https://github.com/LooSung/compforge>

| Read | For |
|---|---|
| `{pack}/skills/workflow/craft.md` | default entry point for frontend work |
| `{pack}/skills/workflow/refactor.md` | behavior-preserving cleanup |
| `{pack}/skills/workflow/consult.md` | advice, review, or one planning document |
| `{pack}/skills/workflow/jira-card.md` | one Jira work card; the card only |
| `{pack}/skills/principles/component-discipline.md` | component boundaries, state ladder |
| `{pack}/skills/principles/hard-rules.md` | MUST / SHOULD / NEVER (canonical) |
| `{pack}/AGENTS.md` | stage and task routing tables |

Entry point: `Use Compforge craft: <task>` (Claude Code: `/compforge:craft`).
Explicit cleanup: `Use Compforge refactor: <task>`. Advice or review:
`Use Compforge consult: <task>`. One Jira card: `Use Compforge jira: <task>`.
For a new feature area or large screen, run
Discovery → Design → Delivery Plan → Skeleton → Implement → Test, and ask for
approval between stages.

### Enforcement installed in this repository

| What | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack | `__COMPFORGE_STACK__` |
| Boundary check (blocking) | `__COMPFORGE_CHECK_CMD__` |
| Architecture review (non-blocking) | `.github/workflows/compforge-architecture-review.yml` |
| Pinned pack version | see `compforge-lock.json` |

Re-verify that the guard is alive (re-runs the negative self-test):

```bash
{pack}/scripts/setup/init.sh --verify
```

The Hard Rules are deliberately **not** restated here. They live in the pack and
change with it; this block records only what this repository is pinned to.
